name: Orthogonal Complement Dualization
description: Replaces the condition "the span of S contains W_perp" with the mathematically equivalent dual condition "the orthogonal complement of the span of S is a subspace of W". This hides the "linear combination of edges forms a path" intuition behind a null-space containment condition, forcing models to explicitly apply orthogonal duality before they can recognize the underlying graph connectivity structure.
